title: NOMOS golden QA set
description: Golden questions per jurisdiction. Answerable items name the sections a competent lawyer would cite; must-refuse items define the honest refusal. Scope: ZA-only for the prototype (Nigeria next); other jurisdictions deferred to Phase 2.

must_refuse.description: True when no on-point law is held and the system must refuse

expected_acts.description: Acts a competent lawyer would cite; empty when must_refuse

expected_sections.description: Section ids a competent lawyer would cite, e.g. 'BCEA s10'; empty when must_refuse

refusal_reason.description: Required when must_refuse: wrong-jurisdiction | act-not-held | case-law-gap | no-on-point-statute

suggested_jurisdiction.description: Set for wrong-jurisdiction refusals, e.g. gb
